# ExifReader

Unmodified browser bundle from the npm package `exifreader@4.52.0`.
Source: https://github.com/mattiasw/ExifReader (release v4.52.0).
License: MPL-2.0, included as EXIFREADER-LICENSE.

Used locally in the browser to read embedded capture metadata before compression.
No remote parsing service or CDN is used.
